title: REA Table Auto-Fit Widths, Row Splitting & Floating Wrap Polygons

vectors.name: Cell Width Conversion (dxa)
vectors.description: Validates table and cell width conversion from dxa (twips). 4320 dxa = 3 inches = 4320 twips.
vectors.input: Table width 4320 dxa with available width 10000 twips.

vectors.name: Cell Width Conversion (pct 50ths of percent)
vectors.description: Validates ECMA-376 pct width unit where 5000 = 100% and 2500 = 50%.
vectors.input: Table width 2500 pct (50%) of 10000 twips; 5000 pct (100%) of 9000 twips.

vectors.name: Cell Width Conversion (auto)
vectors.description: Validates table width type auto resolves to available column width.
vectors.input: Table width type 'auto' with available width 8500 twips.

vectors.name: Cell Margins & Padding Resolution
vectors.description: Validates measurement of cell content with horizontal padding additions (tblCellMar and tcMar).
vectors.input: Cell content 'Sample' with 0 twips padding vs 200 twips horizontal padding.

vectors.name: Min Content Width Unbreakable Word Bound
vectors.description: Computes unbreakable word lower bound for auto-fit column solver.
vectors.input: Paragraph with words 'Short' and 'Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious'.

vectors.name: Max Content Width Unwrapped Paragraph Bound
vectors.description: Computes unwrapped single-line paragraph upper bound for auto-fit column solver.
vectors.input: Paragraph 'Hello World from OpenOfficeRS'.

vectors.name: Fixed Table Layout Grid Conformance
vectors.description: Validates that w:tblLayout w:type='fixed' adheres strictly to explicit w:tblGrid column dimensions.
vectors.input: Fixed table layout with grid columns [2000, 3000, 4000].

vectors.name: Auto-Fit Target Width Equals Min Content Width
vectors.description: Validates width allocation when target table width exactly equals sum of minContentWidth.

vectors.name: Auto-Fit Target Width Equals Max Content Width
vectors.description: Validates width allocation when target table width exactly equals sum of maxContentWidth.

vectors.name: Auto-Fit Proportional Interpolation
vectors.description: Validates proportional interpolation between min and max widths when target is intermediate.

vectors.name: Auto-Fit Slack Distribution Exceeding Max
vectors.description: Validates proportional expansion beyond maxContentWidth when target table width > sum(max).
vectors.input: min [1000, 2000], max [2000, 4000], target 9000 (extra 3000 twips distributed 1:2).

vectors.name: Auto-Fit Compression Below Min
vectors.description: Validates proportional compression when target table width < sum(min) subject to min floor.

vectors.name: GridSpan Merged Columns Slack Distribution
vectors.description: Distributes multi-column merged cell excess width proportionally across underlying columns.
vectors.input: Row 1 with 2 single cells, Row 2 with 1 cell spanning 2 columns with long text.

vectors.name: Table Horizontal Alignment (Left)
vectors.description: Validates left table alignment starting at column boundary.
vectors.input: Table width 4000 in column width 8000 at col_x = 1000 with w:jc='left'.

vectors.name: Table Horizontal Alignment (Center)
vectors.description: Validates center table alignment offset = (available_width - table_width) / 2.
vectors.input: Table width 4000 in column width 8000 at col_x = 1000 with w:jc='center'.

vectors.name: Table Horizontal Alignment (Right)
vectors.description: Validates right table alignment offset = available_width - table_width.
vectors.input: Table width 4000 in column width 8000 at col_x = 1000 with w:jc='right'.

vectors.name: Cell Vertical Alignment (Center)
vectors.description: Validates w:vAlign='center' shifting text lines downward by half remaining cell height.
vectors.input: Row height 2000 twips with single line of text and w:vAlign='center'.

vectors.name: Cell Vertical Alignment (Bottom)
vectors.description: Validates w:vAlign='bottom' shifting text lines downward near bottom cell margin.
vectors.input: Row height 2000 twips with single line of text and w:vAlign='bottom'.

vectors.name: Row Pagination with w:cantSplit
vectors.description: Validates that rows with w:cantSplit advance to next page when exceeding remaining height.
vectors.input: Row height 800 with cantSplit=true when only 500 twips remain on page.

vectors.name: Splittable Row Fits on Page
vectors.description: Validates that row fits on current page when remaining page height is sufficient.
vectors.input: Row height 400 when 1000 twips remain on page.

vectors.name: Repeating Header Rows (w:tblHeader)
vectors.description: Validates that rows with w:tblHeader repeat at top of subsequent pages when table splits.
vectors.input: Header row (height 500) and cantSplit data row (height 800) splitting across pages.

vectors.name: Multiple Repeating Header Rows
vectors.description: Validates multiple header rows repeating in exact sequence on subsequent pages.
vectors.input: Two consecutive header rows (heights 300, 400) and data row advancing to page 2.

vectors.name: Floating DrawingML Anchor Wrap Square
vectors.description: Validates wrapSquare text exclusion interval and resulting left/right text intervals.
vectors.input: Anchor bounds (2000, 1000, 3000, 2000) with dist_left=200, dist_right=200 at y=1500.

vectors.name: Floating DrawingML Anchor Wrap TopAndBottom
vectors.description: Validates wrapTopAndBottom completely excluding text within vertical bounds.
vectors.input: Anchor bounds (2000, 1000, 3000, 2000) with wrapTopAndBottom at y=1500.

vectors.name: Floating DrawingML Anchor Wrap Tight Raycasting
vectors.description: Validates raycasting intersection with diamond polygon edges for wrapTight.

vectors.name: Floating DrawingML Anchor Wrap Through Raycasting
vectors.description: Validates raycasting intersection for wrapThrough polygon with horizontal padding.

vectors.name: WordPackage Full Table Layout Integration
vectors.description: Validates WordPackage layout pipeline containing both paragraphs and paginated tables.
vectors.input: WordPackage with baseline document and appended multi-row table.

vectors.name: Test Vectors Manifest Conformance
vectors.description: Validates that specs/evidence/word/3.2.2_vectors.json exists, is valid JSON, and has >= 25 vectors.
vectors.input: specs/evidence/word/3.2.2_vectors.json
